description: Midblock Traffic Counts is a dataset listed in City of Winnipeg open data portal (data.winnipeg.ca), an open data portal (Socrata) of a city, published or maintained by City of Winnipeg. This dataset comprises midblock traffic counts collected by the City of Winnipeg as part of the Traffic Monitoring Program. Midblock traffic counts are conducted using portable sensors called pneumatic road tubes. Coverage: Winnipeg. The portal files it under the category Transportation Planning & Traffic Management. Its tags are devfriendly, midblock, road, sensors, traffic. The table has 9 columns. The portal shows 2025-12-01 as the last data update. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is Canada Open Government Licence. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support traffic, parking and road network studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-soc-data-winnipeg-ca-portal.
